selectChatPrompt.text: Select a channel or node to start messaging.

signed.label: Signed message
signed.tooltip: Signed by the sender (XEdDSA) and verified by your radio.

snr.tooltip: Signal-to-noise ratio as your radio heard it

rssi.tooltip: Signal strength as your radio heard it

mqtt.label: Via MQTT
mqtt.tooltip: Reached the mesh through an MQTT gateway.

udp.label: Via UDP
udp.tooltip: Reached your radio over multicast UDP.

api.label: Via API
api.tooltip: Sent to your radio by an app connected to it.

error.tooLarge: Message is too large to send

detail.noRoute: No route to the destination node was found in the mesh. Try again when more nodes are reachable.
detail.gotNak: A node rejected this message. Try again when the route changes.
detail.timeout: No acknowledgment was received in time. Try again when you have better signal or more mesh coverage.
detail.maxRetransmit: No node confirmed this message. Try again when you have better signal or more mesh coverage.
detail.noChannel: The sender or recipient could not use a matching channel/key for this message.
detail.noInterface: The sender has no usable radio interface for this message.
detail.dutyCycleLimit: Local airtime limits are temporarily blocking sends. Wait before trying again.
detail.rateLimitExceeded: Messages are being sent too quickly. Wait before trying again.
detail.tooLarge: Shorten the message and send it again.
detail.noResponse: The destination received the request, but no app or module responded. Try again when the recipient is reachable.
detail.badRequest: The destination rejected this request as invalid.
detail.notAuthorized: The destination refused this request because it is not authorized.
detail.pkiFailed: The encrypted send path could not be used. Wait for node info or keys to sync, then try again.
detail.pkiUnknownPubkey: The recipient does not know your public key yet. Your node may share its info automatically; try again after it syncs.
detail.pkiSendFailPublicKey: Your node does not have the recipient's public key yet. Wait for node info to sync, then try again.
detail.adminBadSessionKey: The admin session key is missing, expired, or invalid. Request a new session before trying again.
detail.adminPublicKeyUnauthorized: The remote node does not authorize your admin key.

proof.verifiedInfo: The node you addressed proved it received this message.
proof.failedInfo: Something acknowledged this message without the key only the recipient holds.
proof.noKeyInfo: A delivery proof arrived, but there was no key to check it against.
